The rotation's discovery step opens each candidate conversation and binds the id whose URL carries that id and whose page shows the same GPT name; the named root is remembered; the normal rotation then opens a fresh EIC chat. Nothing is sent before binding. No match: the queue is stopped and the slot BLOCKED EIC_GPT_ROOT_UNKNOWN (no slot-by-slot churn). The surface guard does not bind or remember any GPT during discovery. sidepanel: queue-start errors kept in state and shown under the queue buttons (#queueStartStatus) and in the status line until the next successful start. lib/safety-policy.js effort(): whole-word 'pro' ranks 3 (Heavy) by operator decision 2026-09-26.
